high_level_description: The image showcases a luxury smartphone and its packaging and accessories. The phone is a Huawei Mate X3 Ultimate Design, featuring a distinctive red leather back with gold accents around the camera module. The camera module itself is hexagonal and prominently displays the "XMAGE" branding, indicating the high-quality camera system. The top part of the image shows the phone partially open, revealing the interior screen and the hinge mechanism. The phone's design emphasizes elegance and sophistication, with the red leather and gold details creating a luxurious appearance.
